d: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps or IRGC unveiled a new underground missile city on November 21. The underground missile base showcased hundreds of brand new missiles along with missile launchers mounted on trucks. The footage released by the IRGC also showcased a first-of-its-kind dual missile launcher mounted on a truck, appearing to carry what looked like the Shahab class and Qadr class of liquid-fueled missiles. This comes just days after the IRGC revealed another underground missile city which also had hundreds of ballistic missiles along with kamikaze attack drones lined up…
